route.note: Enter and go south down the corridor
Corridor, pull the troggs back to the corner
Oggleflint with a few of his troggs
Walk the loop south then west
Down the ramp into the southern cave
Jergosh first (the strongest of the pair)
Bazzalan last; end of the dungeon

pulls.note: Entry corridor and Oggleflint; take only a few troggs with him.
Southern cave: cultists, then Jergosh, then Bazzalan.

positions.note: Tank dead centre of the platform, back to the lava-free side.
Melee beside the boss, off the tank's flank.
Healer back toward the entry side, in range of the tank but clear of the boss.
Ranged back toward the entry side, off the boss's front.
Tank holds the boss between itself and the group, on the side the party arrives from.
Melee beside the boss, off the tank's flank.
Healer back toward the entry side, in range of the tank but clear of the boss.
Ranged back toward the entry side, off the boss's front.

strategies.text: Only a cleave to watch; face him away from the group. Bring a handful of troggs in so the room is not overwhelming.
Fire Nova at melee range and an Uppercut that launches the tank. Tank him in the middle of the platform so a launch cannot drop the tank into lava. Clear patrols first.
The strongest of the pair: kill Jergosh before his two adds. He curses (Weakness) and casts Immolate.
Poisons the main target and uses Sinister Strike. Kill him first, then the two adds.

notes: Horde-only. OpenMap has no boss pins for this dungeon, so Taragaman (skull icon on the map picture) and Jergosh (tinted chasm room) are art estimates and Oggleflint and Bazzalan have no position. NeedRoll's pins were looked at only as a cross-check (they agree with the Taragaman and Jergosh estimates); nothing was copied from them. The map picture carries two more skull icons (about 0.54,0.29 and 0.69,0.43) that were not matched to a boss. All quest givers are outside (Thrall and Neeru in Orgrimmar, Rahauro in Thunder Bluff, Varimathras in the Undercity).
